chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the takbīr in the two ʿĪds. He said: seven and five.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of 'Allāhu akbar' in the ritual prayer context
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Islamic festivals, ʿĪd al-Fiṭr and ʿĪd al-Aḍḥā
key_terms.خَمْسٌ: five; the stated number of takbīrs in the other of the two ʿĪd prayers
key_terms.سَبْعٌ: seven; the stated number of takbīrs in one of the two ʿĪd prayers

ai.seo_question: How many takbīrs are there in the salat of the two ʿĪds according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the ruling on the number of takbīrs in the salat of the two ʿĪds. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that they are seven and five, indicating the prescribed count in this act of worship.
